title: Approval review
description: Show exactly what an approval will include before confirming it.
useCase: Show exactly what an approval will include before confirming it.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Prepares a local confirmation only; no files are shared and no public link is created.
look: Pale lavender-grey page with a white rounded, softly shadowed card: lilac icon tile, small grey labels, purple checkboxes and a full-width muted purple button.
motion: Clicking the toggle expands the file list from zero height over 200 ms with an ease-out curve while its chevron rotates 90° in 180 ms; checkboxes update the button count.
adapt: The expand is the `.review-files` grid switching `gridTemplateRows` between `0fr` and `1fr` (a 200 ms CSS transition); `inert` keeps hidden checkboxes unfocusable. Replace the file names, `checks` defaults and the `approve` button's action with a real share call.
